match, returns the shipment's most recent messages.", "parameters": {"properties": {"query": {"description": "Words to look for, such as a document type or a problem", "title": "Query", "type": "title": "Record Id", "type": "string"}, "fact": {"description": "What that record shows, in one sentence", "title": "Fact", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["record_id", "fact"], "title": "Evidence", "type": "object"}, "Fault": {"properties": {"document": {"description": "The required document at fault", "enum": ["bill of lading", "commercial invoice", "packing list"], "title": "Document", "type": ["document", "problem"], "title": "Fault", "type": "object"}, "Refiling": {"properties": {"document_id": {"description": "The misfiled document", "pattern": "^DOC-\\d{4}$", "title": "Document Id", "customs_case"], "title": "Refiling", "type": "object"}}, "properties": {"shipment_id": {"pattern": "^SH-\\d{4}$", "title": "Shipment Id", "type": "string"}, "status": {"description": "cause_found: the records or messages show what is holding it; nothing_wrong: they show nothing holds it; undetermined: they don't show the cause", "enum": ["cause_found", "nothing_wrong", "undetermined"], "title": "Status", "type": "string"}, "cause": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "One sentence; null unless status is cause_found", "title": "Cause"}, "fault": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/Fault"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "The document at fault and its problem; required for cause_found, else null"}, "evidence": {"description": "The facts that support the status, one per record or message", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "title": "Evidence", "type": "array"}, "recommended_action": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "One sentence for a person; null if nothing needs doing", "title": "Recommended Action"}, "refiling": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/Refiling"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Set only when the fix is to refile a document filed against another case"}, "open_question": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "description": "For undetermined only: what a person should find out; else null", "title": "Open Question"}}, "required": ["shipment_id", "status", "cause", "fault", "evidence", "recommended_action", "refiling"], "title": "Finding", "type": "object"}}]

match, returns the shipment's most recent messages.", "parameters": {"properties": {"query": {"description": "Words to look for, such as a document type or a problem", "title": "Query", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["query"], "title": "search_messages_input", "type": "object"}},{"type": "function", "name": "report_finding", "description": "Report the finding to Cobalt's case system.", "parameters": {"$defs": {"Evidence": {"properties": {"record_id": {"description": "ID of the record or message that shows the fact", "pattern": "^(SH-\\d{4}|RTM-\\d{5}|DOC-\\d{4}|MSG-\\d{4})$", "title": "Record Id", "type": "string"}, "fact": {"description": "What that record shows, in one sentence", "title": "Fact", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["record_id", "fact"], "title": "Evidence", "type": "object"}, "Fault": {"properties": {"document": {"description": "The required document at fault", "enum": ["bill of lading", "commercial invoice", "packing list"], "title": "Document", "type": "string"}, "problem": {"description": "What is wrong with it", "enum": ["not_uploaded", "filed_against_another_case", "rejected_by_customs"], "title": "Problem", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["document", "problem"], "title": "Fault", "type": "object"}, "Refiling": {"properties": {"document_id": {"description": "The misfiled document", "pattern": "^DOC-\\d{4}$", "title": "Document Id", "type": "string"}, "customs_case": {"description": "The customs case it should be filed against", "pattern": "^RTM-\\d{5}$", "title": "Customs Case", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["document_id", "customs_case"], "title": "Refiling", "type": "object"}}, "properties": {"shipment_id": {"pattern": "^SH-\\d{4}$", "title": "Shipment Id", "type": "string"}, "status": {"description": "cause_found: the records or messages show what is holding it; nothing_wrong: they show nothing holds it; undetermined: they don't show the cause", "enum": ["cause_found", "nothing_wrong", "undetermined"], "title": "Status", "type": "string"}, "cause": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "One sentence; null unless status is cause_found", "title": "Cause"}, "fault": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/Fault"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "The document at fault and its problem; required for cause_found, else null"}, "evidence": {"description": "The facts that support the status, one per record or message", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "title": "Evidence", "type": "array"}, "recommended_action": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "One sentence for a person; null if nothing needs doing", "title": "Recommended Action"}, "refiling": {"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/Refiling"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "Set only when the fix is to refile a document filed against another case"}, "open_question": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "description": "For undetermined only: what a person should
